programs.title: Hostile Planet
programs.desc: There are places with extremely difficult conditions.Living there requires a constant fight for survival, adapting to fierce frosts, heat, storms, snowstorms and heavy rainfall.Access to these areas is often difficult.The situation is worsened by climate change and rare weather events that have impacted many species.The extraordinary cinematography by Guillermo Navarro, who won an Oscar for "Pan's Labyrinth", will better show this intriguing world where danger lurks at every step.

programs.desc: There is a 146-kilometer area between California's Death Valley and Mount Whitney, the highest peak in California.The authors of the program travel through deserts, mountains and wetlands with their camera.

programs.title: Wildes Südafrika - Der 8. Kontinent
programs.desc: South Africa, like the entire continent, is very diverse.This is a place where cold-loving penguins live alongside ostriches that live in sandy areas.Sea snails and lively chameleons also thrive in this climate.South Africa has distinctive geographical features as well as extreme climatic conditions.Wild animals are exposed to constant changes in living conditions.On the west coast you can meet predatory sea lions that specialize in hunting young Cape boobies;in the south, giant crocodiles, lions and deer, and inland - elephants.
